fnol_text: My name is Zara Rasmussen and I live at 716 Ashford Avenue, Fairview, PA 16474. You can reach me on (555) 722-2276 or zara.rasmussen@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 22 April 2025, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00045. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Rasmussen on (555) 722-2276 to acknowledge the claim. Zara confirmed the loss date as 22 April 2025.
Site visit to 716 Ashford Avenue. Neighbour Anika Whitlock was present and confirmed the timeline.
Zara sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
